notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Sculptor of Winter.
Sculptor of Winter does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
description:
Activate a land you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Rimefeather Owl by paying {1}{S}, putting a snow counter on the land, causing the land to become a snow permanent.
Activate Sculptor of Winter by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Sculptor of Winter.
Activate the land with the snow counter on it by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
